habits.name: Strength training
habits.why: Gives you a measurable, visible reason to respect your own body instead of using it as a vending machine for relief.

habits.name: Hard conditioning session
habits.why: Discharges the restless physical energy that would otherwise go looking for the fastest available outlet.

habits.name: Twenty-minute walk
habits.why: Changes your state and your location in twenty minutes, which is exactly what an urge cannot survive.

habits.name: Cold finish to the shower
habits.why: Trains you to stay calm inside discomfort on your own terms, which is the same skill an urge asks for.

habits.name: Fixed wake time
habits.why: Anchors your whole sleep rhythm so you are properly tired at night instead of restless and unsupervised.

habits.name: Asleep by your set time
habits.why: Removes you from the hour when judgement is weakest and the old pattern is strongest.

habits.name: Phone charges outside the bedroom
habits.why: Removes the single most reliable cue at the single most reliable time, before you have to decide anything.

habits.name: No phone for the first hour
habits.why: Starts the day with your attention belonging to you rather than to whatever was optimised to hold it.

habits.name: Screens off an hour before bed
habits.why: Closes the door on the late-night drift that most slips quietly begin with.

habits.name: Daylight within an hour of waking
habits.why: Sets the body clock that makes you genuinely sleepy at a sensible hour instead of wired at midnight.

habits.name: Three lines in the journal
habits.why: Turns a vague, heavy day into specific facts you can actually adjust tomorrow.

habits.name: Log every strong urge
habits.why: Shows you the chain that starts hours before the moment, where it is far cheaper to break.

habits.name: Evening review
habits.why: Examining the day rather than sentencing yourself is what keeps a hard evening from becoming a hard fortnight.

habits.name: Plan tomorrow evening in writing
habits.why: An owned hour costs nothing to arrange in daylight and everything to survive unplanned at 9pm.

habits.name: Ten minutes of stillness
habits.why: Trains the capacity to stay in an uncomfortable state without immediately escaping it.

habits.name: Prayer
habits.why: Replaces the reflex of hiding with the habit of turning toward the one place shame cannot follow you.

habits.name: Scripture reading
habits.why: Keeps grace louder than condemnation, which is the difference between honesty and hiding.

habits.name: One screen-light day
habits.why: Proves to you that the empty hours can be filled by something better than a feed.

habits.name: Gather with your church
habits.why: Puts you in a room with people who know your name, which is the opposite of the secrecy this feeds on.

habits.name: Confession with a trusted brother
habits.why: Shame cannot survive being known and met with kindness, and secrecy is what gives the pattern its power.

habits.name: Name one specific gratitude
habits.why: Noticing what is actually good lowers the pull of a hollow substitute for it.

habits.name: Read a real book
habits.why: Rebuilds the attention span that endless scrolling quietly took, so slow rewards feel worth having again.

habits.name: Practise your skill
habits.why: Gives the empty evening an owner and gives you an outcome that is further along than it was yesterday.

habits.name: One block of focused work
habits.why: Builds the tolerance for effortful reward that the instant kind has been eroding.

habits.name: Weekly check-in with your person
habits.why: A scheduled conversation means you are not only ever making contact after a bad night.

habits.name: Call a friend, voice not text
habits.why: Answers the loneliness underneath directly, instead of letting a counterfeit answer it badly.

habits.name: Do something for someone else
habits.why: Being needed by a real person is the most direct available answer to feeling irrelevant.

habits.name: Time with other men in person
habits.why: Shoulder to shoulder is how most men actually build the friendship that makes secrecy unnecessary.

habits.name: Unhurried time with your partner
habits.why: Attention given to a particular, real person competes directly with an abstraction, and abstractions lose.

habits.name: Eat a real evening meal
habits.why: Tired, hungry and alone is the state most slips are built from, and this removes one leg of it.
